plainLanguage: Section 104 — Punishment of perjury. Provision hii inalinda uadilifu wa ushahidi na administration of justice.
meaning: This provision states the punishment for perjury: imprisonment for seven years.
keyPoints: Read the provision using its exact statutory elements.
Knowledge, wilfulness, materiality or intent must be proved where expressly required.
Procedural/evidential safeguards in the section are part of the legal analysis.

history.summary: Section 104 is in Chapter XI — Offences Relating to the Administration of Justice — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text audited before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Falsehood alone may not satisfy provisions that expressly require knowledge, wilfulness or intent.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Materiality and the statutory connection to proceedings or authorised oath-taking should be established from the evidence.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element na safeguard ya section 104?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
